_comment: workflow-register (DR-1342): the total line count of .github/workflows may only go DOWN; re-freeze lower with `node scripts/workflow-register.mjs --generate`. To RAISE it, edit by hand with a one-line reason here.

raises.reason: A required guard step in ci.yml for subprocess-budget-guard: one `- run:` line, four comment lines and a blank separator. The guard must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) -- verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. The original comment was 17 lines and was folded to four with the narrative in the record, so this is the irreducible cost of the step rather than its first draft.

One NEW workflow, lesson-mail-label.yml (114 lines), which gives the DR-0312 capture lock a road a runner can walk -- it had never been set on a single built thread because the only road stopped for a human approval on every call. The ceiling exists to refuse BLOAT, not to refuse capability; this is a whole new step of an existing Way, not a longer version of one. Its first draft was 119 lines and its header was folded to 17 with the narrative moved into the record and session note, so this is the step's cost and not its first draft. Raised to the measured total, not above it.
